name: Motorcycle for Brainrots
desc:
🏍️ Motorcycle for Brainrots!💨

HOW TO PLAY:
🏍️ Ride your Motorcycle
🌪️ Dodge the gaps below
🧠 Reach rare Brainrots hidden in far zones
📦 Deliver them back to your Base for CASH 💵
⚡ Upgrade SPEED, BOOST, and CONTROL to go further

👍 Like the game and join the group!
